import re

# Parse the file path to extract date, file_name, extension
def parse_file_path(file_path):
    # e.g., "/home/sierra/documents/work/meetings_data/2023-apr-04__slides.ppt"
    base = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # split by __ to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = base.split('__', 1)
    # rest is like "slides.ppt"
    # split by last dot to get file_name and extension
    if '.' in rest:
        file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    else:
        file_name, ext = rest, ''
    return date_part, file_name, ext

# Test on one file
sample = files[0]
date_part, file_name, ext = parse_file_path(sample)
print(date_part, file_name, ext)
